newsitem.title: UK: De La Rue slides after profits shortfall.
newsitem.headline: De La Rue slides after profits shortfall.

text.p: Shares in De La Rue Plc dropped 38-1/2p, or eight percent, to 446-1/2 on Tuesday after the paper and printing group reported lower-than-expected annual profit.
Analysts had forecast pre-tax, pre-exceptional profits in a range of 124 million to 129.5 million stg but the figure came in at 120.2 million.

"The market wasn't too pleased by the figures to say the least," one market maker said. "The company says it will do better after the reorganisation but that is going to take some time yet. There is still a lot of competition out there."
The company said in a statement its banknote printing market continued to suffer from excess capacity.
"Sales volumes of base business...fell during the year and we do not expect any significant advances in sales volume in the immediate future," the company said.
